title: Forestrie rules-of-the-road file frontmatter
description: A versioned constitution: protocol/rules/platform.md or a repo's docs/rules.md. Versioned instead of carrying a status; `amended` replaces `updated` (ADR-0071 section 7).

id.description: The filename stem: rules for a repo's docs/rules.md, platform for protocol/rules/platform.md.

version.description: Semantic version. MAJOR removes or redefines a rule, MINOR adds one, PATCH rewords.

amended.description: Date of the change that set `version`.
